ITEM 1 | Roasted or fried chicken-like piece with golden-brown, glossy, slightly crisp skin and darker brown patches, with small pale granular bits (seasoning or minced garlic/herb flakes) scattered on top; includes a drumstick-shaped piece about 9 cm long and 4 cm thick and a thigh/back section about 8 cm across, covering roughly 25% of the plate; firm, holds shape, with some juices at the edges | 230
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white cooked meat piece with smooth, moist, slightly fibrous surface and no browning, about 6 cm by 3 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the upper-left edge of the chicken pieces on the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Sliced cucumber rounds and half-moons with bright green skin and pale green-white flesh, moist and firm, cut into semicircular slices about 0.5 cm thick and 3 to 5 cm across, arranged in a loose cluster on the lower right of the plate covering about 12% of the plate | 90
